stem: Based on information in the selection “Tiptoeing Scientists,” what can the reader conclude about the Brazilian frogs?

options.label: F
options.text: They make their homes in the treetops.

options.label: G
options.text: Their bright color makes them easy to locate among the leaves.

options.label: H
options.text: Most of their diet consists of dead leaves.

options.label: J
options.text: They have adaptations that help keep them from danger.
